xmldoc.short_description: Create durations from hours or convert durations to hours.

param_input_item.param_description: Numeric hour counts or duration arrays.

param_output_item.param_description: A duration array for numeric input, or double hour counts for duration input.

description.p: Create durations from hours or convert durations to hours.
hours is an elapsed-time conversion helper. Numeric input is stored as seconds in a duration object with hour display format.
Array-valued inputs keep their data shape when the operation supports arrays. Scalar operands are expanded where the implementation defines scalar expansion.
